tasks.short: Requisition tools, equipment and replacement parts after checking stock.

steps.what: Open stock and open orders for the replacement parts
Decide which materials, supplies, tools or equipment to order
Requisition materials, supplies, tools, equipment and replacement parts
Release the requisition for those replacement parts

tasks.design: The {OTHER} maintenance record opens the part the mechanic named, and the {PROCUREMENT} screen shows quantity on hand and any open order. s1 is shorter only because that part id opens those two figures. s3 is shorter only because the part, quantity, equipment and supplier chosen in s2 fill the requisition fields. Choosing the part and releasing the requisition stay at full time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock lived in the store and the open order lived with purchasing, so the supervisor phoned both before typing a blank requisition.
tasks.enabler_now: The part id can open a stock row and an open purchase line that other people already stored. The purchasing screen already has requisition fields.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing whether this part actually fits the failed equipment, and whether the job can wait.
tasks.human_edge: Only the supervisor at the equipment can tell which part to order and whether to release it.

ambition.what: Whether on-hand quantity and open orders were on the screen before the requisition was released, including for a repeat part.

tasks.altitude: The supervisor still chooses the part and still releases the order. Before that, the stock figure and the open order are on the screen. No reorder runs without that release.

reach.task: Name the part on the job card before asking for it
reach.learn: Which part name was missing, so the supervisor had to type it

reach.task: Post the quantity received against the part
reach.learn: Which stock figure was missing when the supervisor asked

evidence.claim: IFS Ultimo links maintenance records to ERP and the supply chain. That link is what puts stock and an open order beside the equipment. The page does not say the product chooses the part.
Whether the part fits the failed equipment, and whether to release the requisition, stays with the supervisor. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Stock row producer is the storekeeper at goods receipt. Fields: part id, quantity on hand, location, received time. If the row is missing, the supervisor asks the storekeeper or counts the bin inside s1, and that time stays in the 50 percent.
Need producer is the mechanic on the job card. Fields: equipment id, part name, quantity, why it failed. If the card has no part name, the supervisor types those fields inside s1.
Open-order producer is the purchasing clerk. Fields: part id, quantity still due, supplier, status. If there is no line, s1 shows none. The supervisor does not invent one.

There is no par level and no automatic reorder. s2 and s4 are unchanged and stay at full time. s3 only copies the part, quantity, equipment id and supplier the supervisor already chose onto the native requisition screen.
s4 releases the requisition written in s3. The supervisor may edit that text and then confirms the edited text. The release does not go out on an earlier version.
unknowns: Whether this shop's purchasing screen can show quantity on hand, or only the maintenance record can.
research_questions: How often the job card already names a part id before the supervisor looks up stock?

already_counted.description: Check a missing stock figure, or type a part name the job card did not hold.
Check the requisition fields filled from the part just chosen.

incremental.description: When purchasing retires a supplier, drop that supplier from the requisition list. About twice a year.

approvals.approved_version: Requisition on screen at release: part, quantity, equipment and supplier written in s3, plus any edit made before release.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeat part the supervisor already knows is short. They still look at the equipment and still release the order. The form is shorter only when the job card already named the part. When the mechanic only described the noise, the supervisor types the part and the saving is the stock lookup alone.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with personnel and record the grievance and resource needs.

steps.what: Open the last note before you confer with personnel
Confer with the customer, management, engineering, quality control and union workers' representatives
Resolve employee grievances raised in the meeting
Identify and review resource needs, then record how you coordinate activities

tasks.design: Before the meeting the {OTHER} maintenance record opens the open jobs and the last coordination note. That open is shorter only because the meeting topic finds those two records. Conferring, and resolving the grievance, stay in the room at full time. Afterwards the supervisor types the resource need and the outcome into fixed fields, which is what the next meeting opens. The room is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last agreement sat in a notebook, and a grievance does not exist as a record until someone has heard it.
tasks.enabler_now: A work order id can open the job and the previous note. Fixed fields can replace a blank page after the meeting. No model is needed to hear a person.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing a grievance fairly, and agreeing resource needs with people who want different things.
tasks.human_edge: Only the supervisor in the room can hear the grievance and agree what happens next.
tasks.altitude: The meeting is unchanged. Before it, the last note and the open jobs are on the screen. Nothing about who may resolve a grievance changes.

reach.task: Raise the grievance in the meeting
reach.learn: Which outcome was written only after it was heard, and which note was empty

reach.task: Say which resource the job still needs
reach.learn: Which resource need was typed after the meeting, and which job had no priority on the pack

evidence.claim: The cited works-council statute requires consent before a system processes staff data or can monitor attendance, behaviour or performance. A named grievance note is staff data. This design does not record the meeting.
Coordinating the work and resolving a grievance are conversations in the room. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Work-order producer is the mechanic or the planner. Fields: work order id, equipment, priority, skill asked, status. If a job is missing, the supervisor hears it in the meeting, not from a blank system row.

Last-note producer is this supervisor at the previous meeting. Fields: date, who was there, resource need, quantity, grievance outcome, review date. The first meeting starts from empty fields inside s1.
A new grievance is created in s3, when it is heard. s1 does not open a grievance that nobody has written yet.
s2 and s3 are unchanged and stay at full time. s4 is shorter only because those fixed fields replace a blank page. No model drafts the outcome. The room is not recorded.
unknowns: Whether grievance notes are stored in the maintenance record or in a separate personnel file at this company.
research_questions: How often the supervisor opens the last coordination note before a meeting that is mostly a grievance?

already_counted.description: Open the last note and see which jobs on the pack have no priority.
Type the resource need and the grievance outcome into the fixed fields after the meeting.

incremental.description: When the meeting starts tracking a new kind of resource need, add that field to the note. About twice a year.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A corridor talk where nobody opens the last note and nobody writes fields afterwards. Conferring with personnel and resolving the grievance stay the whole task. The note is shorter only when the meeting actually ends with a resource need worth recording.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine schedules, sequences and assignments from open jobs.

steps.what: Read equipment quantity, priority and the skill tags
Determine schedules, sequences and assignments for work activities
Tell personnel the schedule based on who can do the job
Record each assignment against the job on the board

tasks.design: The {OTHER} maintenance record shows open jobs, the quantity of equipment, and the shift roster the supervisor already keeps. s1 is shorter only because the shift date opens that list instead of collecting slips. Determining the schedules and telling personnel stay at full time. s4 is shorter only because the names just chosen fill the assignee field. The list does not score or rank anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Jobs arrived as slips and shouts, and who can do the work sat in the supervisor's head.
tasks.enabler_now: A job id can show priority, equipment quantity and a skill tag someone already stored. The assignment itself is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the sequence when two breakdowns arrive and only one person can do either.
tasks.human_edge: Only the supervisor can judge priority against who is actually able to do the job today.

ambition.what: Whether the open jobs, the equipment quantity and the shift roster were on the screen before the crew was assigned, including on a quiet morning.

tasks.altitude: The supervisor still sets the schedule and still tells the crew. Before that, the open jobs are on one list. No model assigns people.

reach.task: Do the job they were assigned
reach.learn: Which assignment they cannot do unaided, and which job was typed onto the board by hand

reach.task: Log the job with a priority and a skill required
reach.learn: Which job had no priority, so the supervisor learned it by walking the floor

evidence.claim: The cited works-council statute requires consent before a system processes staff data or can monitor attendance, behaviour or performance. Storing who is assigned to a job is a personnel record. The list is not a clock and does not score the crew.
The cited annex makes AI that monitors and evaluates workers' performance high-risk. Ranking mechanics would be that. This list does not rank them. The supervisor assigns.
Setting the sequence and matching a person to a job is a judgement on the morning. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Job producer is the mechanic or the planner. Fields: job id, equipment id, priority, hours, skill required, quantity of that equipment. If a breakdown is not logged, the supervisor types it inside s1, and that time stays in the 45 percent.
Roster producer is this supervisor. Fields: person, on this shift yes or no, date. It is a list they type. It is not a clocking feed and it does not monitor attendance.

Skill-tag producer is this supervisor on a counseling note. Fields: person, skill name, can do unaided yes or no, date confirmed. If the tag is missing, s2 assigns from what the supervisor knows, at full time. The tag is not a score.
s2 and s3 are unchanged and stay at full time. s4 only writes the assignee the supervisor already named. Nothing on the board ranks the crew.
unknowns: Whether the shift roster already exists as a list, or only as names the supervisor remembers.
research_questions: How often a morning starts with jobs that nobody has logged, so the board is incomplete?

already_counted.description: Read the job list and type a breakdown that was not logged.
Check the assignee written back onto each job.

incremental.description: When the crew's skill list gains a skill name, add it to the tag list. A few times a year.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A morning when several breakdowns were never logged, so the supervisor still walks the floor to learn what failed. Determining the schedules and telling personnel stay the whole task. The board helps only for jobs that were already logged, and the assignee line is the only shorter write.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel employees on work issues and record the next practice.

steps.what: Open the last note on this employee's skill deficiencies
Assist employees to correct the skill deficiencies
Record the practice agreed for those skill deficiencies

tasks.design: The {TALENT} note opens the last practice for that employee. s1 is shorter only because the staff identifier finds that note. Counseling, and agreeing how to correct the deficiency, stay in the room at full time. s4 is shorter only because fixed fields replace a blank page. The talk is not recorded, and no model names the deficiency.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last practice sat in a notebook, and whether this person can hear the point is only clear in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: The staff identifier can open the note the supervisor stored last time. The conversation needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: Saying the deficiency in a way the employee can use, and choosing a practice they can do on this shift.
tasks.human_edge: Only the supervisor in the room can tell whether this employee can hear the point and can practise it.
tasks.altitude: The conversation is unchanged. Before it, the supervisor sees the last practice. Nothing about who may judge the employee changes.

reach.task: Practise the skill named in the note
reach.learn: Which next practice was written, and whether the last note was empty

reach.task: Assign work the next morning using the skill tag
reach.learn: Whether the employee can do the skill unaided, and the date that tag was confirmed

evidence.claim: The cited works-council statute requires consent before a system processes staff data or can monitor behaviour or performance. A note about a skill deficiency is staff data. This design does not record the conversation.
The cited annex makes AI that evaluates workers' performance high-risk. No model names the deficiency or scores the employee. The supervisor counsels.
Counseling about a work issue and agreeing a practice stay a conversation in the room. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Last-note producer is this supervisor after the previous counseling. Fields: person, skill name, what was seen, next practice, can do unaided yes or no, date. The first session starts from empty fields inside s1, and that time stays in the 45 percent.
s2 and s3 are unchanged and stay at full time. The room is not recorded. No model drafts what the deficiency is.

s4 is shorter only because the fields person, skill, what was seen, next practice and date replace a blank page. That note is what the next session opens, and it is the skill tag the schedule can read.
Works-council consent for storing these notes is required before the screen is switched on. Until then the supervisor keeps today's notebook and s1 is a lookup in that notebook at full time.
unknowns: Whether this shop already stores skill notes against a staff identifier, or only on paper.
research_questions: How often counseling happens with no previous note, so the open is a blank form?

already_counted.description: Read the last skill note, or start from blank fields when there is none.
Write the next practice into the fixed fields after the conversation.

incremental.description: When the shop renames a skill, rename that field on the note. About twice a year.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A talk on the floor where nobody opens the last note and nobody writes fields afterwards. Counseling the employee and agreeing the practice stay the whole task. The note is shorter only when there was a previous note to open and a practice worth writing down.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The supervisor still chooses the part, still hears the grievance, still sets the schedule and still counsels. Before those acts they can see stock, the last note and the open jobs. No model orders a part, resolves a grievance, assigns a mechanic or names a deficiency.
reach: Mechanic (which part name was missing from the job card, and which assignment they cannot do unaided)
Storekeeper (which stock figure was missing when the supervisor asked)
Planner (which job had no priority and had to be learned on the floor)
Union representative (which grievance was heard in the room and written only afterwards)
skills_to_grow: Reject a requisition when the part does not fit the equipment
Reject an assignment when the person cannot do the job safely today
Reject a skill note that names a deficiency the employee did not discuss
role.ambitious_version: On the morning round the supervisor sees which jobs, which parts and which skill notes are already filled in, and spends the time on the assignment and the person. A grievance is still heard in the room before anyone writes the outcome. The supervisor still decides.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Mechanics, Installers, and Repairers
